name: vinci
description: Save the videos and newsletters you care about, get short notes on each one, and ask ChatGPT about everything you've saved.

interface.longDescription:
Vinci keeps the videos and newsletters you care about in one place and writes short notes on each one: what it's about, the main points, and why it matters to you. With this plugin you can use all of it right here in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Ask about anything you've saved, like "What did I save about pricing?", and get answers that link to the exact second of the video.
- Read the notes on any saved video or newsletter, or its full text when you need the exact words.
- See new videos from the creators you follow each day, then keep the good ones and skip the rest.
- Paste a video link and ask ChatGPT to save it, or ask it to follow a creator.
- In the ChatGPT desktop app, @-mention a saved video to bring its notes into the chat.

Who it's for: anyone who follows more podcasts, talks and long videos than they have time to watch, and wants to remember what they learned.

Good to know: Vinci only works with the videos and newsletters you've saved or follow (and ones people share with you). It doesn't search videos you haven't saved. New saves take a few minutes before you can ask about them. The plugin never deletes anything. You need a Vinci account, and you can create one while connecting.
capabilities: Ask about anything you've saved and jump to the exact moment in the video
Read short notes on any saved video or newsletter: main points, why it matters, quotes, full text
See new videos from the creators you follow and keep or skip them
Save a video link or follow a creator just by asking
@-mention saved videos in the ChatGPT desktop app
defaultPrompt: What have I saved about cutting AI model costs? Show me the best moments.
What's new in my Vinci triage today?
Why is the last video I saved relevant to me?

positive.description: Search the vault by topic and cite moments
positive.prompt: What have I saved in Vinci about cutting AI model costs? Give me the best moments with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_vault and answers only from matching items in the user's vault, citing each video title with a link to the exact moment. It does not invent items that are not in the vault.

positive.description: Summarize the most recently saved video
positive.prompt: Summarize the most recent video I saved to Vinci.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_videos with sort 'added' to find the newest saved item, then get_video, and returns Vinci's notes on it - TL;DR, key points and why it matters for the user - with a link to the video.

positive.description: Show the triage of new videos
positive.prompt: What's waiting in my Vinci triage?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the new arrivals from followed channels that wait for a keep/skip decision, most relevant first (or opens the Vinci app view showing them). If triage is empty, says so.

positive.description: Keep a video in the vault
positive.prompt: Save this video to my Vinci vault: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CBYhVcO4WgI
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save_video with the link and confirms the video was added to the vault (or was already there), noting it becomes searchable once Vinci has prepared its notes.

positive.prompt: Follow the Y Combinator channel in Vinci.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls follow_channel with the channel handle or URL and confirms Vinci now follows it (or already did); new uploads will arrive in triage.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Ljubljana tomorrow?

negative.description: General video search outside the user's vault

negative.prompt: Delete every video in my Vinci vault.

review.commerce_description: Vinci sells nothing inside ChatGPT. The plugin never shows plans, prices or checkout links; subscriptions are managed on use-vinci.com.

publication.release_notes: Plainer listing text, and clearer help for new accounts: when your vault is empty, Vinci now offers to follow creators or save a video link, and the app shows how to get started.
